newsitem.title: USA: Proffitt's to offer $100 mln senior notes.
newsitem.headline: Proffitt's to offer $100 mln senior notes.

text.p: Proffitt's Inc said Friday it plans to offer $100 million of senior notes due 2004 to qualified institutional buyers, institutional accredited investors, and foreign investors.

The regional department store chain said the offering is being made to reduce its secured borrowings and debt-bearing interest at floating rates, to extend maturities, and to increase its financing flexibility.
Net proceeds will be used to repay mortgage and other secured debt. The balance will be used to reduce revolving credit borrowings and for general corporate purposes, it said.

It said it is seeking to amend its senior bank credit facility to, among other things, increase the committed amounts from $275 million to as much as $350 million and extend the maturity of the facility by five years.

It said it is also pursuing a restructuring of its accounts receivable financing arrangements to extend the term of a portion from one year to between three and five years through the sale of fixed-rate asset-backed securities.

The company said the notes it plans to offer have not been registered with U.S. regulators and may not be offered or sold in the U.S. without a registration or unless exempted from registration under federal and state securities laws.
